$comment: Ramping Speedster (OS Octavia model, wiki 2026-11: Sonic Boom / Flow State / Bass Drop). Electroweb = Sonic Boom: a piercing wave, NORMAL hit + 35 % slow for 1 s on the first enemy, LIGHT 50 % hits + 0.25 s slow on the rest. Charge = Flow State: +33 % speed for 2.5 s, any hit (Strike and the ball included) resets it, cooldown starts when it ends. Thunder = Bass Drop: 1 s wind-up, then 5 pulses 0.25 s apart around Pikachu (475 diameter), which moves freely meanwhile. Player knockback = OS × 1.875; power % → powerRatio. Speed and wave size aren't on the wiki: our guesses.

moves.name: Electroweb
moves.desc: Launch a crackling web that passes through enemies. The first one hit is slowed 35 % for 1 s; the rest take LIGHT hits.

moves.name: Charge
moves.desc: +33 % speed for 2.5 s. Every hit you land (Strikes on the ball too) resets the timer. The cooldown starts when it runs out.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.desc: After 1 s, 5 thunderclaps strike around you, 0.25 s apart, blasting enemies and the ball away. You can keep moving.
